class: Cached extraction substituted a degree subtype
symptom: The original resume lists B.Tech but cached history supplied B.S. Chipotle was already submitted when discovered; MANTECH was corrected before advancing.
root_cause: A generic Bachelor profile level only overrode field of study, leaving an unsupported extracted subtype ungrounded.
fix: Ground generic degree subtypes in the matching original resume row before runtime history use; explicit owner degree overrides still win.
why_tests_missed: Education fixtures trusted the extracted subtype and did not compare it with the matching original resume row.
prevention: Test generic and explicit owner degree levels against original source rows, and preserve unrelated schools.
